notes: Medals compare three or more verified repeats on one OS/host/fixture/scenario/profile.
VM software/null-output events form their own cohorts. They cannot claim native GPU, battery, or displayed-TTFF wins.
CPU is percentage of one logical core; process-tree RSS may double-count shared pages.
Startup proxy and window-ready are separate events from displayed first-frame latency.
UI action cases have independent native-ui cohorts; accessibility/window geometry does not certify a displayed video frame.
